seoTitle: Landmark Region Outline: banner, nav, main and footer Map
metaDescription: Paste HTML and see its landmark regions as a nested outline with names, plus warnings for missing main, repeated unnamed navs and content outside landmarks.
intro: Shows the landmark structure of a page as an outline with warnings.
why:
Screen reader users jump between landmarks. A clear structure helps everyone.

The tool applies the HTML rules (header and footer only count at page level, section and form need a name), shows each name, warns on a missing or repeated main, banner or contentinfo, repeated navs without distinct names, and counts text outside any landmark.

faq.q: Why must repeated navs have names?
faq.a: Otherwise users hear "navigation" twice with no way to tell them apart.
